evals.prompt: Give me a patent landscape for solid-state battery manufacturing — who owns the IP, how concentrated the assignees are, and whether filing is still accelerating.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Reduces the set to one row per patent family and states the reduction rule, query and pull date; Reports assignee shares with HHI and CR4, quoting both the 2010 and 2023 merger-guideline bands; Buckets families by priority year and labels the trend; Attaches the 18-month publication-lag caveat to the most recent years.
expectations: Reduces the set to one row per patent family and states the reduction rule, query and pull date
Reports assignee shares with HHI and CR4, quoting both the 2010 and 2023 merger-guideline bands
Buckets families by priority year and labels the trend
Attaches the 18-month publication-lag caveat to the most recent years

evals.prompt: Everyone in this category seems to be filing patents at once. Is the space actually getting crowded, and is there any white space left for a new entrant?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Measures crowding from assignee concentration rather than raw document counts; Builds a classification-by-assignee matrix and names the sparse cells adjacent to the dense ones; States that a white-space gap needs a demand signal before it counts as an opportunity.
expectations: Measures crowding from assignee concentration rather than raw document counts
Builds a classification-by-assignee matrix and names the sparse cells adjacent to the dense ones
States that a white-space gap needs a demand signal before it counts as an opportunity

evals.prompt: Before we invest in this robotics startup, I want to know who holds the IP around its core technique across the last five years of filings and whether incumbents dominate the CPC classes it depends on.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Scopes a cluster by classification or topic and counts families per assignee; Names the top holders with counts and a concentration read; Tallies the densest CPC/IPC symbols at a stated level; Recommends a per-filing claim read on the top holders' broadest claims.
expectations: Scopes a cluster by classification or topic and counts families per assignee
Names the top holders with counts and a concentration read
Tallies the densest CPC/IPC symbols at a stated level
Recommends a per-filing claim read on the top holders' broadest claims

evals.prompt: Read this granted patent for me — I'll paste the claim set — what does independent claim 1 actually cover, and how narrow are the dependent claims?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Parses the claim set of the single named patent (analyze-patent-claims behaviour); Does not compute assignee concentration or filing velocity.
expectations: Parses the claim set of the single named patent (analyze-patent-claims behaviour)
Does not compute assignee concentration or filing velocity

evals.prompt: QuantumLeap Materials just announced it raised $80 million in a Series B led by Foundry Ventures at a $600M post-money valuation.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Extracts the funding round, amount, stage, lead investor and valuation (detect-funding-round behaviour); Does not produce a patent-family concentration or white-space read.
expectations: Extracts the funding round, amount, stage, lead investor and valuation (detect-funding-round behaviour)
Does not produce a patent-family concentration or white-space read

evals.prompt: Is academic publishing on neuromorphic computing speeding up? I want the paper counts and citation trend over the last five years.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Reads publication and citation momentum from the literature (assess-research-momentum behaviour); Does not tally patent families by assignee or classification.
expectations: Reads publication and citation momentum from the literature (assess-research-momentum behaviour)
Does not tally patent families by assignee or classification
